Keep identifiable Japanese temple proportions. Remove all visitors, stalls, signs, side buildings, incense burner and sky. Do NOT draw Kaminarimon or the five-story pagoda. Sparse neutral BLACK contour drawing, no heavy filled areas. Landscape 4:3 framing, whole roof and base uncut with white breathing room. Perfectly flat opaque PURE WHITE #FFFFFF background inside and outside gaps. No shadow, gradient, paper texture, gray wash, glow, checkerboard, transparency, text, labels, border or watermark.
